title: Kitesurf: Agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates
summary: Kitesurf is Cloudflare's experimental agent-first browser architecture designed to run web browsing tasks efficiently in V8 isolates at the edge, enabling AI agents to interact with websites without traditional browser overhead.
problem_solved: Reduces the computational cost and latency of running browser-based AI agents by executing browser tasks in lightweight V8 isolates at Cloudflare's edge network instead of traditional virtual machines.
why_valuable: It enables scalable, cost-effective browser automation for AI agents by leveraging Cloudflare's global edge infrastructure, potentially revolutionizing how AI crawlers and scrapers operate.
